1995.kid: Your internet company rents a line from the phone company that is always on, all the way to a bigger network. It carries the parcels of all its customers: 2 million bits a second.
1995.nerd: A leased E1 (G.703/G.704): 2.048 Mbit/s in 32 timeslots of 64 kbit/s. Slot 0 keeps the frames in step and the other 31 are one pipe for Cisco HDLC. A small ISP often bought less, 64 or 128 kbit/s (one or two slots), or a Frame Relay circuit.
